The GCC Runtime Library Exception, version 3.1, permits linking the GCC
runtime libraries into a program that is not itself licensed under the GNU
General Public License, provided the program is an Eligible Compilation
Process: the Target Code is generated by a compilation process that does not
pass the GCC Runtime Library's Independent Modules through a non-GPL-compatible
plugin. Its full text is published at
https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gcc-exception-3.1.html and is not reproduced
here. This notice is a summary, not the exception.
